PaginationControlsWidth.reason: Button labels changed from the short placeholder to 上一页/下一页 and increased the true child width
PaginationControlsWidth.fix: Recalculated all six control variants from actual child widths (392px) and reordered the grid by Position rows and State columns

StatusTagFontFamily.reason: StatusTag master labels still used Inter and caused a product-font mismatch when reused in DataTable
StatusTagFontFamily.fix: Set all five StatusTag master labels to Noto Sans SC Regular without changing size or semantic styling

SearchPanelHeaderHeight.reason: The 38px expand/collapse button overflowed a 24px header row by 7px
SearchPanelHeaderHeight.fix: Set every SearchPanel header row to a fixed 38px height

SearchPanelSearchingActionsFit.reason: The wider loading button caused the searching-state reset action to clip at the right edge
SearchPanelSearchingActionsFit.fix: Reduce the three primary filter instance widths from 168px to 160px across all states

ButtonPaintFallback.reason: Bound paints required resolved fallback RGB values for reliable Figma screenshot rendering

InputFormFieldStateTextProperties.reason: Global Content and Helper TEXT properties overwrote state-specific examples; Label remains the TEXT property while state examples remain local

SelectChevronGeometry.reason: The right chevron glyph inherited y=0 during creation and rendered asymmetrically
SelectChevronGeometry.fix: Set glyph-right y to 6 to align both chevron legs

StatusTagStateTextProperty.reason: A shared Label TEXT property intentionally uses one component-set default and therefore cannot preserve five different master labels
StatusTagStateTextProperty.resolution: Keep Label editable with default 状态 and add five business-example instances with per-instance text overrides

StatusTagScreenshotSpacing.reason: Business examples touched the page screenshot boundary

PageHeaderDocumentationHeight.reason: The documentation frame retained its initial fixed height and clipped the final usage notes
PageHeaderDocumentationHeight.fix: Set vertical sizing to AUTO and disable clipping; resolved height is 235px

DialogContentAndActionsWidth.reason: The initial horizontal sections hugged content, which compressed the operation copy and left-aligned the footer actions
DialogContentAndActionsWidth.fix: Set Header, Operation Summary, and Actions to the 432px inner content width; preserved 24px component padding and right-aligned the footer

PageStateSkeletonFit.reason: The initial Skeleton included a redundant footer placeholder that touched the fixed 300px component boundary
PageStateSkeletonFit.fix: Removed the redundant footer placeholder and retained the title, description, and three content-row skeletons

Dashboard.dataBoundary: Only fixed Mock snapshot records and explicitly labeled Mock sample counts are shown; unresolved aggregate metrics are not fabricated
Dashboard.adminBoundary: Admin quick entrances are limited to confirmed P0 capabilities: attendance and course center

CourseList.dataBoundary: Course 4001 remainingSeats is rendered from Mock field; course 4002 full state uses frozen conflict scenario; undefined location and duration render as —

CourseDetail.dataBoundary: Course 4001 and trainer 3001 fields are rendered from frozen Mock data; remainingSeats and action eligibility are backend-provided; raw resource URLs and employee-hidden budget are not rendered

RequestCreate.dataBoundary: Course 4001, employee 1001 and department 101 are rendered from frozen Mock context and cannot be changed on this page; duplicate request 5001 remains isolated in CONFLICT-001 and is not mixed into SCN-REQ-01

MyRequests.dataBoundary: Only TrainingRequest 5001 from FLOW-SNAPSHOT-02 is shown for employee 1001; wireframe sample rows R002 and R003 are not treated as frozen Mock data and are not rendered

RequestDetail.requestReason: 提升数据库设计与查询能力
RequestDetail.roleActionBoundary: Employee PENDING view is read-only; manager approval and HR filing actions are not rendered
RequestDetail.dataBoundary: TrainingRequest 5001, employee 1001 and course 4001 are rendered from FLOW-SNAPSHOT-02; null approval timestamps and remarks are represented as waiting/not-started states and are not fabricated

DepartmentApproval.dataBoundary: Only TrainingRequest 5001 from FLOW-SNAPSHOT-02 is shown for manager 1002 within department 101; no additional department requests or aggregate counts are fabricated
DepartmentApproval.permissionBoundary: Department manager sees only authorized department requests; approval is per request, with no batch approval and no HR filing action

HrFiling.dataBoundary: Only TrainingRequest 5001 from FLOW-SNAPSHOT-03 is shown; the snapshot changes the request to DEPT_APPROVED but does not provide an approval timestamp or remark, so both remain explicitly unavailable
HrFiling.permissionBoundary: HR employee 1003 can file only DEPT_APPROVED requests; no department approval, batch filing, duplicate filing, or administrator-only action is rendered

MyRegistrations.dataBoundary: Only Registration 6001 from FLOW-SNAPSHOT-05 is shown for employee 1001; SIGNED_IN, COMPLETED, ABSENT, and CANCELED remain separate snapshot states and no extra registrations are fabricated
MyRegistrations.permissionBoundary: Employee 1001 sees only personal registration data; cancellation is shown only for REGISTERED before course start, with no HR operation, rating, or certificate action in this state

RegistrationDetail.dataBoundary: Registration 6001 and Attendance 7001 are rendered from FLOW-SNAPSHOT-06; undefined actualHours renders as — and is not derived from course duration or deduction
RegistrationDetail.permissionBoundary: Employee 1001 sees only the personal registration detail; SIGNED_IN is read-only and does not expose cancellation, rating, certificate, manager approval, HR filing, or attendance-management operations

AttendanceManagement.dataBoundary: Only Registration 6001 from FLOW-SNAPSHOT-05 is shown for Course 4001; course statistics are undefined in the frozen Mock and therefore render as — instead of being derived from the visible row
AttendanceManagement.permissionBoundary: HR employee 1003 can query registrations and operate attendance; in REGISTERED first state only sign-in and detail are rendered, while mark-absent waits for course end and complete-training waits for SIGNED_IN plus backend eligibility

MyCertificates.dataBoundary: Only Certificate 10001 from FLOW-SNAPSHOT-08 is shown for employee 1001; no expired certificate is fabricated and VALID is rendered from the frozen Mock displayStatus instead of being derived from dates
MyCertificates.permissionBoundary: Employee 1001 sees only the personal certificate and detail action; certificate generation, notification, editing, printing, PDF, and QR code capabilities are not rendered

CertificateManagement.dataBoundary: Only Registration 6001 from FLOW-SNAPSHOT-07 is shown as COMPLETED with no certificate record; actual hours and test scores remain unknown instead of being fabricated
CertificateManagement.eligibilityBoundary: The first state proves only COMPLETED registration and absence of a certificate; the test threshold is explicitly pending confirmation and final eligibility is revalidated by the backend during generation
CertificateManagement.permissionBoundary: HR 1003 can inspect the candidate and initiate certificate generation; administrator inheritance and reminder, editing, printing, PDF, and QR code capabilities are not rendered

CertificateDetail.dataBoundary: Certificate 10001 is rendered from FLOW-SNAPSHOT-08 with the frozen certificate, employee, course, issue and expiry values; VALID is not derived from dates
CertificateDetail.permissionBoundary: Employee 1001 sees only the personal certificate business fields; HR sees read-only employee, department, registration and reminder context; P2 reminder action and print or derived-file capabilities are not rendered

Forbidden.dataBoundary: The fixed 403 page shows only the signed-in account and role, without identifying the original page, resource, record ID, or permission code
Forbidden.securityBoundary: Route guards improve experience but backend APIs still validate access; the page does not reveal whether a restricted resource exists

NotFound.dataBoundary: The fixed 404 page presents invalid address, removed record, and incorrect link as parallel possibilities without confirming a specific target state
NotFound.securityBoundary: Public and authenticated users receive the same non-disclosing feedback; no resource existence, internal route, record ID, SQL, connection, or stack information is exposed
